big: A client says, 'Just guarantee me 12%.' An RM cannot. Market-linked products have no guaranteed returns, and any hint of a guarantee is misleading and against the distributor code of conduct.

lines: Can I say, 'Over ten years you will not lose'?

No. You can share history honestly: longer periods have historically reduced the chance of loss. You cannot turn history into a promise. Suitability comes first: risk profile, horizon, liquidity needs and goals. And a client who asks for a guarantee is often anxious. Address the anxiety, not the literal request.
